name: Uchida Youko
source:
She attends a well-known school and is the quiet, introverted type who worries about what others think; even when groped, she tends not to make a scene.

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041023222235/http://www.bishoge.jp/scoop/products/museum/yuwaku.htm]ScooP archived page[/url]]
